# MCP discovery API

Inspect public MCP discovery metadata without executing tools.

Use [API authentication](authentication.md) for protected requests. Examples use your own resource IDs and a temporary token; saved response examples are synthetic.

| Method | Path | Operation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/v1/mcp/config` | [Get MCP connection configuration](#op-get-v1-mcp-config) |
| `GET` | `/v1/mcp/tools` | [Discover MCP tools](#op-get-v1-mcp-tools) |
| `GET` | `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/v1/mcp` | [Get MCP protected resource metadata](#op-get-well-known-oauth-protected-resource-v1-mcp) |
| `GET` | `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` | [Get OAuth authorization server metadata](#op-get-well-known-oauth-authorization-server) |

## Get MCP connection configuration {#op-get-v1-mcp-config}

`GET /v1/mcp/config`

Read supported transports, connection URLs, and OAuth settings.

Authentication: public; no bearer token required.

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

```sh
curl --fail-with-body --request GET "$ADIOS_API_URL/v1/mcp/config"
```


### Response: HTTP 200

Successful response. Inspect returned state for operations that start asynchronous work.

A complete response-body schema is not published for this custom operation. Inspect the returned content and status; no payload is assumed here.

## Discover MCP tools {#op-get-v1-mcp-tools}

`GET /v1/mcp/tools`

Read public tool names and input schemas. This does not execute any tools.

Authentication: public; no bearer token required.

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.

## Get MCP protected resource metadata {#op-get-well-known-oauth-protected-resource-v1-mcp}

`GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/v1/mcp`

Authentication: public; no bearer token required.

## Get OAuth authorization server metadata {#op-get-well-known-oauth-authorization-server}

`GET /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server`

Read OAuth discovery metadata, including authorization, registration, and token endpoints.

Authentication: public; no bearer token required.

### Request example

Set `ADIOS_API_URL=https://api.adios.dev`. For protected requests, set `ADIOS_ACCESS_TOKEN` and `ADIOS_TEAM_ID` as in the [quickstart](quickstart.md). Set any additional `ADIOS_*` variables from your own resource results.
